decisions.why: range names its own products as pediatric fracture fixation hardware (PediNail, Pediatric Nailing Platform, Cannulated Screws, PediFrag wrist/clavicle, PediFlex, PediLoc Femur, SCFE, PNP Tibia, Rigid Nail Extraction Set, Plate and Screw Hardware Removal Set) — trauma & fixation, crawled from orthopediatrics.com (TOS3-awarded entity's own global brand site)

plate/screw/nail systems for correcting bone deformity (PediLoc Tibia, LCB Plate, LPF Plate, DFOS, PediPlates, PLEO, PediFoot, PAO, Transphyseal Screws, 3D-Printed Cut Guides, LCB Removal Set, Pediatric Plating Platform Hip) — implants, not acute trauma fixation

limb-lengthening and growth-modulation implant systems (Fassier-Duval Telescopic IM System, GAP Nail, Hinge Pediatric Plating System, LolliPOP, Free-Gliding SCFE Screw System, SLIM, GIRO Growth Modulation System, DPOS) plus their fitting accessories — implants

spinal correction rod/screw systems (ApiFix, RESPONSE 4.5/5.0, RESPONSE 5.5/6.0, RESPONSE Neuromuscular, RESPONSE Rib and Pelvic System, FIREFLY, BandLoc, VerteGlide) — implants; no dedicated spinal-implant type exists under ortho so this is the closest gated fit
bioresorbable fixation hardware (Bioretec Cannulated ActivaScrew, OSSIOfiber suture anchors/compression staple/screws/nails) — implants by name
circular/rail external fixators and their removal hardware (ORTHEX Large/Small Bone Circular Fixator, Mini Rails, DRIVE Rail, Ex Fix Hardware Removal Set) — trauma & fixation
surgical navigation/planning technology (7D FLASH Navigation System, Playbook) — equipment & robotics
single product, MPFL Reconstruction System — a ligament-reconstruction implant/anchor kit; no dedicated soft-tissue-repair type exists under ortho so this is the closest gated fit
